newsitem.title: UK: IPE GAS OIL CLOSES UP $1 AFTER QUIET AUG EXPIRY.
newsitem.headline: IPE GAS OIL CLOSES UP $1 AFTER QUIET AUG EXPIRY.

text.p: IPE September gas oil closed up $1 at $170.75 a tonne on Tuesday after a quiet expiry of the August contract, brokers said.
The strength of Brent, up 14 cents at $18.72 a barrel at 1645 gmt, which stemmed from vigour in the U.S. gasoline futures market, failed to transfer to the gas oil pit, brokers said.

"We're up a dollar but its been pretty quiet and gas oil has lost ground against practically everything else," said one broker. August's expiry at a $2 discount to September helped drag the new front-month down, he added.
Physical delivery will be 778 lots, or 77,800 tonnes.
